- Iterate over all suffixes of the input from full string to empty: for i from 0 to len(s), check if s[i:] is a palindrome (use s[i:] == s[i:][::-1]); track the smallest i where the suffix is palindromic (i.e., the longest palindromic suffix).
- Take the prefix before that suffix, s[:i], reverse it, and append to the original string to form the result.
- Handle edge cases: empty string returns empty; single-character strings return themselves; the algorithm naturally covers cases where the entire string is already a palindrome (i becomes 0, so no extra characters appended).
